name: What are common mistakes to avoid during home restoration before selling?

mainEntity.name: What are common mistakes to avoid during home restoration before selling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoid over-personalizing renovations, as unique tastes may not appeal to a broad market. Another common mistake is overspending on upgrades that won't yield a proportionate return, like luxury finishes in a mid-range neighborhood. Neglecting essential repairs in favor of cosmetic updates is also ill-advised, as these can deter buyers during inspection. Lastly, failing to secure proper permits can lead to costly delays and legal issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid over-personalizing, overspending on low ROI upgrades, neglecting essential repairs, and failing to secure necessary permits during pre-sale restoration.
